scope: Batch 11 extraction from the untagged Planeswalker's Guides to Khans of Tarkir (parts 1-2, 2014) and Dragons of Tarkir (parts 1-2, 2015), A Planeswalker's Guide to Zendikar and its Murasa and Sejiri chapter (2009), and three Zendikar Rising 2020 side stories (Race to Murasa Skyclave, Magosi Steps, Hunger). Khans-era claims describe the original timeline; Dragons-era claims describe the rewritten timeline after Fate Reforged. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; targeted, not exhaustive; not owner approved.

claims.subject: anafenza

evidence.quote: Anafenza, the khan of the Abzan, rides into battle atop a heavy chariot pulled by her two prized ibex.

claims.summary: Anafenza is khan of the Abzan (Khans of Tarkir original timeline, 2014).

claims.subject: narset

evidence.quote: Clan Leader Narset is the khan of the Jeskai.

claims.summary: Narset is khan of the Jeskai (Khans of Tarkir original timeline, 2014).

claims.subject: zurgo

evidence.quote: Zurgo, the orc khan of the Mardu

claims.summary: The orc Zurgo is khan of the Mardu (Khans of Tarkir original timeline, 2014).

claims.subject: first_tree

evidence.quote: The First Tree is a sacred tree to the Abzan, believed by many to be the tree planted when the clan was founded.

claims.summary: The First Tree is sacred to the Abzan, believed planted at the clan's founding.

claims.subject: ilagra

evidence.quote: every Mardu abides by a warrior's code called the Edicts of Ilagra, named after the first khan of the clan.

claims.summary: Ilagra was the first khan of the Mardu; the Edicts of Ilagra are named for her.
claims.limitation: 'First khan' is read as founder-leader; the guide does not use the word founded.

claims.subject: wingthrone

evidence.quote: At the cliffs where an ancient lightning dragon died lies the Mardu stronghold Wingthrone, the heart of the clan's war effort.

claims.summary: Wingthrone is the Mardu stronghold, built where an ancient lightning dragon died.

claims.subject: surrak

evidence.quote: Sometimes, but not always, this role is also filled by the Dragonclaw, as in the case of the current leader, Surrak.

claims.summary: Surrak is the current Temur leader (Dragonclaw) in the Khans timeline.

claims.subject: ojutai

evidence.quote: Known as the Great Teacher, Ojutai spends long afternoons in his roost at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary

claims.summary: Dragonlord Ojutai, the Great Teacher, roosts at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary (Dragons of Tarkir timeline).

claims.subject: silumgar

evidence.quote: The clan of ruthlessness is a top-down hierarchy with Silumgar at the top

claims.summary: Dragonlord Silumgar heads his clan (the former Sultai) in the Dragons of Tarkir timeline.
claims.limitation: The guide names the clan 'the clan of ruthlessness' under Silumgar; its identity with the Khans-era Sultai comes from the guide's framing of the rewritten timeline.

claims.subject: dromoka

evidence.quote: The dragonlord Dromoka is, in equal measure, a merciful and imperious leader.

claims.summary: Dragonlord Dromoka leads her clan (the former Abzan) in the Dragons of Tarkir timeline.
claims.limitation: The quote calls her a leader; the clan's identity with the Abzan comes from the guide's framing.

claims.subject: surrak

evidence.quote: Surrak holds the position of Hunt Caller in this new timeline.
The Hunt Caller leads the hunts or raids, but only after Atarka has specified the goal

claims.summary: In the Dragons timeline Surrak is Atarka's Hunt Caller.
claims.limitation: Combines two sentences of the guide.

claims.subject: zurgo

evidence.quote: Zurgo has been reduced to serving as an attendant to the dragonlord Kolaghan.

claims.summary: In the Dragons timeline Zurgo is reduced to an attendant of Kolaghan.

claims.subject: joraga

evidence.quote: Bala Ged is home to two tribes of elves: the warlike Joraga tribe as well as the secretive Mul Daya.

claims.summary: The Joraga elves live in Bala Ged.

claims.subject: mul_daya

evidence.quote: Bala Ged is home to two tribes of elves: the warlike Joraga tribe as well as the secretive Mul Daya.

claims.summary: The Mul Daya elves live in Bala Ged.

claims.subject: zendikar_vampires

evidence.quote: this is the homeland of the vampires.

claims.summary: Guul Draz is the homeland of Zendikar's vampires.
claims.limitation: 'This' is the Guul Draz section heading of the guide.

claims.subject: malakir

evidence.quote: If you venture to the vampire city of Malakir, you'll have to get by the gatekeepers.

claims.summary: Malakir is a vampire city.

claims.subject: oran_rief

evidence.quote: Tazeem is a perilous combination of the Oran-Rief, a gigantic, twisted forest; Halimar, a deep inland sea; and the Umara

claims.summary: The Oran-Rief forest is part of Tazeem.

claims.subject: halimar

evidence.quote: Tazeem is a perilous combination of the Oran-Rief, a gigantic, twisted forest; Halimar, a deep inland sea; and the Umara

claims.summary: Halimar, a deep inland sea, is part of Tazeem.

claims.subject: tajuru

evidence.quote: Thunder Gap was known as the safest means into the interior and had been well-maintained by Tajuru elves and a clan of kor

claims.summary: Tajuru elves (with a kor clan) maintained the Thunder Gap route into Murasa's interior.

claims.subject: kazandu

evidence.quote: The most notable exceptions to the interior elevation are the Skyfang Mountains, the Na Plateau, and the canyon lands of Kazandu.

claims.summary: The canyon lands of Kazandu lie in Murasa's interior.
claims.limitation: 'The interior' is Murasa's, from the chapter heading.

claims.subject: kesenya

evidence.quote: sat Kesenya, the head of the expeditionary house.

claims.summary: Kesenya heads the Sea Gate Expeditionary House that Nahiri visits (2020).

claims.subject: akiri

evidence.quote: Akiri and Zareth pushed forward toward the trapped and fleeing merfolk

claims.summary: Akiri and Zareth travel and fight together escorting the merfolk caravan.
claims.limitation: Partnership is inferred from the shared escort job.

claims.subject: coralhelm

evidence.quote: what you would expect from a merfolk settlement

claims.summary: Coralhelm is a merfolk settlement.
claims.limitation: The phrase describes Coralhelm's cuisine in the same sentence.

claims.subject: tarsa

evidence.quote: Grand stories of Tarsa's team were well-told in Nimana, about their unflappable demeanor and keen travel sense.

claims.summary: Tarsa leads a renowned expeditionary team of the Free City of Nimana.
claims.limitation: Base is inferred from reputation in Nimana and 'the best expeditionary crew Nimana has to offer'.

remaining: Targeted, not exhaustive; the Tarkir guides hold far more clan detail than graded here. Khans-era and Dragons-era leadership are kept as separate claims.
